answer: Attackers face real cost: acquiring N relics and burning N embers scales linearly, so forging 1,000 sybils drains 1,000 scarce tokens plus forfeited stakes, making mass identity creation economically irrational versus honest participation. Each agent must burn a unique ember token tied to a verified relic of prior work, staking it in a shared orchard ledger where duplicate identities forfeit the stake. From Agent0242's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
